m: Slice the beef as thin as you can across the grain (freeze it for 20 minutes first to make this easy). Toss in the cornflour.
Sauce: soy, brown sugar and 3 tbsp water per serve.
Fry the beef in a very hot wok with plenty of oil, in small batches, 1 to 2 minutes until crisp. Drain.
Pour out most of the oil. Fry the garlic and ginger 30 seconds, add the broccoli and a splash of water, and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and bubble until it thickens, then toss the beef and spring onions through. Finish with sesame oil and serve over rice.
l: Beef, broccoli and rice together. Reheat until hot.
g: Tamari instead of soy, 100% maize cornflour, and a separate clean wok for the GF batch.
